items.title: Ulta Beauty (ULTA) Turns Wellness Boutiques Into A Bigger Beauty Aisle Fight
items.summary: Ulta Beauty (NasdaqGS:ULTA) is ramping up wellness-focused shop-in-shop concepts as beauty and self-care gain shelf space in big-box retail. Walmart is expanding its own beauty and wellness aisles with more premium brands, putting direct pressure on Ulta Beauty's core category mix. Retail partners and suppliers are increasingly treating wellness as a separate growth pillar, reshaping how Ulta Beauty positions its boutiques versus mass retailers. items.title: UPS Partners With TikTok Shop for No-Box, No-Label Returns Service
items.summary: UPS (NYSE:UPS) has entered into a partnership with TikTok Shop to provide an exclusive no-box, no-label returns service for participating sellers on the social commerce platform in the United States. The service will be provided through Happy Returns, allowing TikTok Shop customers to return eligible products without packaging or printed shipping labels.

items.title: Ulta Beauty (ULTA) Expands In Stores On An Undervalued Narrative
items.summary: Ulta Beauty (ULTA) quietly widened its in-store lineup this month as Wavytalk, Flower Knows, and COSRX moved from online-only launches into physical aisles with exclusive tools, colorways, and curated assortments. These in-store launches arrive after a strong 90-day share price return of 21.76% for Ulta Beauty, even though the year-to-date share price return is down 11.44% and the 1-year total shareholder return has slipped 0.83%.
